title: Add and remove a dependency
description: Read what a video bar depends on and what depends on it, try an edge that would close a cycle and read the server's refusal, then add a real upstream and remove it again.

steps.caption: Boardroom A holds one system. Its video bar is fed from a power conditioner and hosts the room's touch panel.
Expand it to the component's view.
Dependencies lists what the bar needs and what needs it. Add an upstream; the picker never offers the bar itself.
Try the touch panel, which the bar already hosts.
The server refuses a loop and says why, in place. Nothing was recorded.
A real upstream instead, the amplifier.
Reached through it, a path dependency.
It is recorded, and the amplifier joins the upstream list with its health.
Remove it again. A confirm says what changes first.
The edge is gone; the power conditioner is still the bar's upstream.
